I am sure that Bob will agree with me if I say the '92 season was a tough one! It may have been the Olympics, injuries, holidays, or even people deciding not to come out and play, but we were spread real thin.

Talking of Aham, he had turned up without his trainers but as a true team manager Bob went barefoot for the rest of the afternoon. Another man with his sights on a major games was decathlon man Simon Shirley.

He had intended taking only one leap, for a few points, but paid for it by putting his back out and making it impossible for him to take any further part in the afternoon's activities - in turn bad news for Team Manager Bob who then had to fill in most of the blanks himself.
